name: augie_academic_advising_a2ui_agent
description: Augustana University (Sioux Falls, SD) Persona-Scoped Academic Advising Agent (AAA) with WCAG 2.2 AAA A2UI v0.9 Output for Gemini Enterprise.

hostingArchitecture.runtime: Google Cloud Run (A2A v0.3 HTTP Service)
hostingArchitecture.note: Per Zion Cloud Solutions' Gemini Enterprise A2UI v0.9 specification, Vertex AI Agent Engine is not supported for A2UI agents. Deploy to Cloud Run and grant roles/run.invoker to the Discovery Engine service agent (or use OAuth behind a custom domain / Load Balancer / Apigee).
hostingArchitecture.safety: Invoke Google Cloud Model Armor directly inside the agent and re-validate all A2UI form action payloads server-side.
hostingArchitecture.fileDelivery: Send downloadable files (e.g., PDF degree audits, Financial Aid SAP CSV exports) as A2A file parts, never via ADK save_artifact.

extensions.description: Gemini Enterprise A2UI v0.9 declarative UI protocol extension
